name: Contradiction and Supersession Semantics
description: Detect contradictory memories. Define which supersedes which based on source, time, and confidence. Contradictory memories are not simply deleted but marked with supersession metadata.
purpose: Maintain knowledge consistency by detecting and resolving contradictory information, ensuring the memory system presents the most authoritative version while preserving the contradiction history for audit.
acceptanceCriteria: Contradiction detection: same subject, same predicate, conflicting object values
Supersession rules: newer > older, higher confidence > lower, authoritative source > weaker
Contradictory memories are linked with supersession metadata
Original memory is preserved, not deleted — marked as superseded
Recall excludes superseded memories by default, can include with override flag
rollback_strategy: Restore superseded memories to active; disable contradiction detection
recovery_strategy: Re-evaluate all contradictions from triple store; rebuild supersession chains
